title: Machine Learning - Synthetic Data Generation
summary: A project that generates synthetic tabular data for the Bovine Tuberculosis open dataset from Ireland's data.gov.ie, comparing GaussianCopula, CTGAN, and TVAE model outputs evaluated with the table_evaluator library. SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer) are directly instantiated with custom constraints and metadata schemas to produce and compare the synthetic datasets.
evidence: GaussianCopula_Code.py:45 'synthesizer = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata)'; CTGAN_Code.py:45; TVAE_Code.py:45 instantiate SDV synthesizers with custom constraints
